title: Melting Teacup Dreamscape
description: A giant white teacup tilts in a vast grassy field, pouring a glowing orange liquid that forms a river toward the foreground. Rows of empty red chairs and tables are arranged on both sides under a twilight sky, framed within a cracked, weathered oval wooden border resembling an old television screen with moss and peeling paint.
prompt: Surreal scene of a giant cracked white teacup tilted on its side in the middle of a vast grassy field at twilight, pouring glowing molten orange liquid that flows like a river between hundreds of empty red chairs and tables arranged in neat rows, small glowing orbs and flowers scattered around, dramatic purple and teal sky with falling sparks, the entire image contained within a thick weathered wooden oval frame that looks like an old broken television screen with moss and peeling paint on the edges
